name: Driver card
description: The driver's name and number, once a driver is assigned.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/driver-card", name: "Driver card", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The driver's name and number, once a driver is assigned.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    If(condition: options.order.driver_name, then: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
      Box(shape: BoxShape.circle, width: 44, height: 44, alignment: Anchor.center, background: Color.primary, child: Icon(name: Icons.user, color: Color.primaryInk)),
      Expanded(child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [Text(child: options.order.driver_name, weight: FontWeight.semibold), Text(child: "Your driver", size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted)])),
      If(condition: options.order.driver_phone, then: Text(child: options.order.driver_phone, weight: FontWeight.medium))
    ])))
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "order", type: Order, required: true)],
)
